description: A shared set of synonym rules. SynonymSets belong to an Organization and can be referenced by SearchConfigurations. Cannot be deleted while referenced by any SearchConfiguration.

id.description: The unique ID of this synonym set.

organizationName.description: The name of the Organization this resource belongs to.

name.description: Display name. Unique within the organization.

description.description: Optional description of the synonym set.

rules.description: The list of synonym rules in this set.

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that last modified this resource.
